description: Call this tool to export the timesheet to a CSV file (excel-friendly) you can hand to a bookkeeper: one row per entry with hours, billable, rate, currency and amount. Returns the file path written.

from.description: ISO date/time lower bound. On the free tier the export is clamped to the last 7 days; Pro exports the full history.

path.description: Target file path; a relative path resolves against the working directory. Defaults to a timestamped file in the local data directory, and the full path is returned.

to.description: ISO date/time upper bound. On the free tier the export is clamped to the last 7 days; Pro exports the full history.

name: export_csv
title: Export entries to CSV
